faq.q: What is an AI product video generator?
faq.a: It turns a product photo into a short video that shows the item, an operation, or a product detail.

faq.q: How is this different from image to video?
faq.a: Image to video adds motion to a still. Product video focuses on a product operation or buyer question.

faq.q: Can I use the video on Etsy or Shopify?
faq.a: Yes. Etsy listing videos follow Etsy’s current listing rules, and Shopify accepts the finished media beside your product photos.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Available lengths are 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives the operation a clear start and finish.

faq.q: Will the video show my product accurately?
faq.a: Review the finished clip beside the real item before posting. Use supported product details and replace any result that drifts.

faq.q: Can I add the price and product name?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact text later in Canva, CapCut, or your ad editor so names, prices, and dates stay correct.

faq.q: Can I use a close-up operation shot?
faq.a: Yes. A close view helps shoppers inspect a latch, button, lid, seam, or other useful detail.

faq.q: Can I use product videos for paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Download the demo, add campaign text in your editor, and review the final ad before launch.
